environment.restart_method: terminate the packaged OpenObsidian process and relaunch the same packaged binary

observations.detail: workspace-state.json contained the fixture vault root, Welcome.md in openTabs and activePath Welcome.md before the process restart.
The packaged OpenObsidian process was terminated and relaunched; the OpenObsidian window returned with the same titlebar and workspace shell.

The post-relaunch accessibility tree exposed Open vault, Quick switcher, Command palette, left-sidebar toggle, centered workspace title, right-sidebar toggle and Settings in the titlebar; the ribbon exposed Open vault, Command palette, Quick switcher, Graph, Settings and History.

After selecting the same fixture folder through the native picker, the Standard vault showed Board.canvas, Second.md, Views.base and Welcome.md, restored the Welcome.md tab and active source editor, and rendered outline/backlinks context.
The visible status footer reported the fixture was opened with a no-op scan verified; the four fixture file hashes were unchanged by the restart/readback.

limitations: This is a macOS arm64 packaged-app readback; Windows/Linux and reference Obsidian restart behavior remain separate validation work.

The fixture is intentionally disposable and was reopened through the explicit native picker; richer Markdown dialect coverage, screen-reader/input/IME validation and the remaining named UX surfaces remain pending.
